name: Turn-Based Doors
description: A door that opens and closes on a turn-based rhythm — open = empty cell, closed = wall.
howToPlay: Each successful box tap counts as one turn. After the door's countdown hits zero, it flips state. Tap boxes in front of the door any time, but the boxes behind only open up while the door is up. If closing would trap every remaining box, the door locks open (∞) for the rest of the game so you can finish.
author: prototype/turn-based-doors

showcaseLevel.name: Doorway Rhythm
showcaseLevel.desc: Time your taps around the door
